import csv

cat={}
for r in csv.reader(open(CATALOG_CSV)):
    if r[0]=='timeseries_id': continue
    cat[r[1]]=r[0]  # point_uri -> timeseries_id

vals={}
for ts, tstamp, val in csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if ts=='timeseries_id': continue
    vals.setdefault(ts, {})[tstamp]=val

zones=[
 ("Perimeter_mid_ZN_1","Zone_F3_Z04"),
 ("Perimeter_bot_ZN_3","Zone_F2_Z02"),
 ("Perimeter_bot_ZN_4","Zone_F2_Z05"),
 ("DataCenter_mid_ZN_6","Zone_F2_Z08"),
 ("Core_top","Zone_F4_Z01"),
 ("Core_bottom","Zone_F2_Z01"),
 ("Perimeter_bot_ZN_1","Zone_F2_Z04"),
 ("DataCenter_top_ZN_6","Zone_F2_Z09"),
 ("Core_mid","Zone_F3_Z01"),
 ("Perimeter_mid_ZN_3","Zone_F3_Z02"),
 ("Perimeter_mid_ZN_4","Zone_F3_Z05"),
 ("Perimeter_top_ZN_2","Zone_F4_Z03"),
 ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Zone_F4_Z04"),
 ("Perimeter_bot_ZN_2","Zone_F2_Z03"),
 ("DataCenter_bot_ZN_6","Zone_F2_Z07"),
 ("Perimeter_top_ZN_3","Zone_F4_Z02"),
 ("Perimeter_top_ZN_4","Zone_F4_Z05"),
]
T="2018-04-09T16:00:00"
res=[]
base="http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#"
for name,zu in zones:
    tpu=base+zu+".Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor"
    spu=base+zu+".Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint"
    tid=cat.get(tpu); sid=cat.get(spu)
    if not tid or not sid:
        res.append((name,None,None,None,'missing '+str((tid,sid))))
        continue
    tv=vals.get(tid,{}).get(T)
    sv=vals.get(sid,{}).get(T)
    if tv is None or sv is None:
        res.append((name,tv,sv,None,'noval'))
    else:
        res.append((name,float(tv),float(sv),float(tv)-float(sv),'ok'))

for r in sorted([x for x in res if x[3] is not None], key=lambda x:-x[3]):
    print(r)
print("---missing---")
for r in [x for x in res if x[3] is None]:
    print(r)
